verdict.rationale: a-Shell ships Vim for terminal-based editing and explicitly documents running syntax checkers via vim-lsp or ALE, plus compilers/interpreters (clang, Python, Lua) to run code directly in-app. However, evidence lacks detail on setup/configuration of these lint plugins, dedicated lint tool installation, or independent hands-on confirmation that these checkers work reliably in the sandboxed iOS environment. Missing for 10: independent corroboration of vim-lsp/ALE working in-app, details on installing/configuring specific linters, broader language lint support beyond the mentioned example.
